_comment: Edit ONLY the values below. google_drive_root is the ONE folder holding all client data -- a local, Google-Drive-for-Desktop-synced path on YOUR machine, not a path inside this project. Inside it, each client or test dataset has its own folder with Input and Output subfolders. Set active_client to the folder the next cycle should run on (or set the BR_CLIENT environment variable for a single run). Use forward slashes even on Windows.
_input_model: Each cycle, each client's Input folder should hold exactly ONE file: a multi-tab Excel workbook is the expected/best-supported case (one tab per category -- see .claude/skills/business-review-automation/references/standard-input-file-templates.md), but a single .docx, .pdf, or .pptx is also accepted and extracted best-effort into the same categories.
_fallback_if_drive_not_configured: data/<active_client>/Input and data/<active_client>/Output inside this project folder
_root_note: Project's own data folder. Reorganised 1 Nov 2026 into one folder per client/dataset (CLNT-1, TEST-Meridian-FY2025, TEST-Halcyon-FY2025), each with Input/Output; the old data/inputs + data/outputs and G:/My Drive/Business_Review_Agent runs were merged in (G: copied, left in place). Previous roots: C:/BusinessReview (29-30 Oct 2026); G:/My Drive/Business_Review_Agent (Input_Files / Output_Files).
